profile_text.body:
Palantir is a public company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Palo Alto, trading under the ticker PLTR. Its website describes the company as building software that empowers organizations to effectively integrate their data, decisions, and operations, using the tagline "Foundational Software of Tomorrow. Delivered Today."

The company's AI product is Palantir AIP, an enterprise AI platform with Ontology-based governance, a defense and intelligence focus, and influence over high-stakes decisions. SEC records list CIK 0001321655.

Court records show Palantir in connection with Haugland v. Anthropic PBC in the District Court of Delaware.
